svg.title: A branded key: two ceremonies and one vote

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: A branded key: two ceremonies and one vote

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Who acts, what the chip holds after each stage, and the one-way doors on the way.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: A blank ATECC608 gets the quorum-v2 rulebook; the chip makes its brand key.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Edition stamped in OTP. Serial and brand public key go into the batch file.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The batch folds into one Merkle root, published in the repo.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Keyholders compare the root on their consoles, hold green: one transaction.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The chip makes your Safe key in slot 0, signs two tests, then seals slot 0.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The brand key signs the chip's statement: this key, this chip, sealed.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Anyone submits the statement. The contract checks the batch proof,

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: the brand key's signature, and that the key is neither revoked nor bound.
